texts.preamble: Mahesh Chouksey vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 17 February, 2026 High Court Of Chhattisgarh At Bilaspur Rahul Jha Crmp No. 792 of 2019 17:32:53 +0530 Mahesh Chouksey versus The State Of Chhattisgarh Order on Board 17/02/2026
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that due to a bona fide mistake, instead of filing an appeal under Section 76(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the present matter has been filed as a Criminal Miscellaneous Petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. It is further submitted that the matter was initially presented as a Criminal Appeal; however, on account of confusion, it was corrected and placed as a CRMP. It is, therefore, prayed that the cause title be permitted to be corrected and necessary amendments be incorporated in the petition so as to treat the same as an appeal under Section 76(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that due to a bona fide mistake, instead of filing an appeal under Section 76(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the present matter has been filed as a Criminal Miscellaneous Petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. It is further submitted that the matter was initially presented as a Criminal Appeal; however, on account of confusion, it was corrected and placed as a CRMP. It is, therefore, prayed that the cause title be permitted to be corrected and necessary amendments be incorporated in the petition so as to treat the same as an appeal under Section 76(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
